description_en: Associates a vSwitch in a virtual private cloud (VPC) with a multicast domain by calling the AssociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain operation so that resources in the VPC can communicate through multicast
description_zh: 为了VPC下的资源可以实现组播通信，调用AssociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain接口将专有网络（VPC）下的交换机（VSwitch）关联到组播域中
kebab_example: aliyun cbn associate-transit-router-multicast-domain --transit-router-multicast-domain-id tr-mcast-domain-91wpg6wbhchjeq0000 --transit-router-attachment-id tr-attach-g3kz2k3u76amsk0000 --vswitchids vsw-p0wxk12u6okfkr8xy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the multicast domain
parameters.name: transit_router_multicast_domain_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC connection
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without associating the vSwitch with the multicast domain. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business restrictions. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, the vSwitch is associated with the multicast domain
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会将交换机关联至组播域。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接将交换机关联至组播域
parameters.name: dry_run
